title: Armenian Genocide
summary: Wikidata item Q80034, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "systematic destruction of the Armenian people and identity in the Ottoman Empire during World War I implemented by the Ottoman authorities through mass murder". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
